# Liquid Glass optical shader

Source: https://github.com/QWEA0/Liquid-Glass-Android
Revision: 16afe4d8b5d08a370d3f8c50b08d7f5c6eb5da4d
File: liquidglass/src/main/java/com/example/liquidglass/GlassLensRenderer.kt
License: MIT (full upstream notice in LICENSE).

GlassShader.java adapts LENS_AGSL to a Java string. GlassOptics supplies uniforms
and a shared, bounded backdrop for MargyT's existing Android Views. The original
Kotlin library, Compose, native libraries and Android resources are not bundled.
